'''Sentinel''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Phrourossaron" (ARS316) is a suspected Aggeloid attempt at mimicking the shape and attack patterns of humanity's sentry guns. Despite its massive range, the Sentinel is a sessile organism.}}

==Overview==
An [[Aggelos]] that shaped like an artillery, the Sentinel is notably immobile, however it has extremely large attack range, allowing them to bombard Operators from far distance.

Its only attack is fires at an area after a long wind up, dealing Physical damage.
